column2: Descendants of a master shadow kingmaker. Their blood carries supreme cunning, unparalleled plot secrecy, and natural authority among court intriguers.
column3: Descendants d'un maître de l'intrigue et des secrets.
column4: Nachkommen eines Meisters der Ränke und Geheimnisse.
column6: Descendientes de un maestro de las intrigas y los secretos.

column2: Forged through triumphant blood feuds and judicial duels. Their scions fight with terrifying combat prowess and command unbreakable battlefield morale.
column3: Forgée dans les querelles de sang victorieuses.
column4: Geschmiedet in siegreichen Blutfehden und Ehrenduellen.
column6: Forjada en victoriosas venganzas de sangre y duelos de honor.

column2: The dreaded scions of a ruthless ruler who governed through terror, purges, and iron force. Vassals tremble before their iron gaze.
column3: La lignée redoutée d'un tyran sans pitié.
column4: Die gefürchtete Blutlinie eines unbarmherzigen Herrschers.
column6: El temido linaje de un tirano despiadado.

column2: Through profound penitence and righteous governance, the founder washed away their ancestral curse, leaving a legacy of divine favor and unwavering vassal devotion.
column3: Une lignée purifiée par la piété et la justice.
column4: Eine durch Frömmigkeit und Sühne gereinigte Blutlinie.
column6: Un linaje purificado por la piedad y la justicia.

column2: Perform a grand dynastic ceremony to permanently inscribe your dynasty's legendary achievements into an immortal bloodline.
column3: Graver les exploits de votre maison dans l'histoire.
column4: Verewigt die Taten Eures Hauses in einer unsterblichen Blutlinie.
column6: Inmortalizar las hazañas de vuestra casa en un linaje imperecedero.

column2: Your deeds have echoed across realms and generations. Chroniclers, heralds, and lords gather as your dynasty's eternal legacy is formally consecrated into blood and law.
column3: Vos exploits sont gravés dans l'histoire pour les générations futures.
column4: Eure Taten hallen durch die Geschichte und begründen ein unsterbliches Erbe.
column6: Vuestras hazañas resuenan en la historia, fundando un legado inmortal.

column2: We shall weave the shadows forever.
column4: Wir werden für immer im Schatten weben.

column2: Our steel shall avenge our honor.
column4: Unser Stahl wird unsere Ehre rächen.

column2: Our house is cleansed in holy grace.
column4: Unser Haus ist in Gnade gereinigt.
column6: Nuestra casa queda purificada en la gracia.

column2: Heralds ride throughout the known world proclaiming the founding of your legendary bloodline! Knights swear oaths, and future scions will carry your blood with proud distinction.
column3: Les hérauts proclament la gloire de votre nouvelle lignée !
column4: Herolde verkünden den Ruhm Eurer neugegründeten Blutlinie!
column5: ¡Los heraldos proclaman la gloria de vuestro nuevo linaje!

column2: The Order of the Whispering Quill
column6: La Orden de la Pluma Susurrante

column2: A clandestine brotherhood of spymasters, cipher-weavers, and kingmakers who manipulate realms through blackmail, covert infiltration, and stolen secrets.
column3: Une confrérie secrète de maîtres espions.
column6: Una hermandad secreta de maestros espías.

column2: Spend society currency to purchase classified intelligence and rumors about foreign courts.
column3: Dépenser des jetons pour acheter des rumeurs.
column6: Gastar fichas de susurro para comprar rumores.

column2: Deploy covert agents into this ruler's court to compromise their security and cripple their plot defense.
column3: Infiltrer la cour de ce souverain.
column6: Infiltrar la corte de este gobernante.

column2: Use the society's master scribes to forge stolen succession records, granting you a strong claim on this title.
column6: Falsificar documentos de sucesión para obtener un derecho.

column2: Mobilize the entire society's network to uncover and neutralize all hostile plots targeting your dynasty.
column3: Mobiliser le réseau pour déjouer tous les complots.
column4: Deckt alle feindlichen Komplotte gegen Euer Haus auf.
column6: Movilizar la red para neutralizar complots contra vuestra casa.

column2: Whispers in the corridors suggest this character belongs to an illegal underground network of spies and kingmakers.
column3: Des rumeurs affirment que cet individu appartient à un réseau illégal d'espions.
column4: Gerüchte bringen diesen Charakter mit einem illegalen Spionagenetzwerk in Verbindung.
column6: Rumores sugieren que este personaje pertenece a una red ilegal de espías.

column2: Exposed as a member of the criminal Whispering Quill brotherhood! Feared, despised by the church, and legally liable for imprisonment and title revocation.
column3: Dénoncé publiquement comme membre d'une société criminelle.
column6: ¡Expuesto públicamente como miembro de la hermandad criminal!

column2: Your shadow contacts deliver a packet of sealed scrolls detailing illicit affairs, faction whispers, and vulnerable treasuries across neighboring realms.
column3: Vos contacts vous livrent des parchemins secrets.
column6: Vuestros contactos os entregan pergaminos secretos.

column2: Our covert ciphers have successfully embedded themselves in the target court. Their council chambers are now an open book to our brotherhood.
column3: Nos agents ont infiltré la cour avec succès.
column4: Unsere Agenten haben den Hof erfolgreich unterwandert.
column6: Nuestros agentes han infiltrado la corte con éxito.

column2: With wax seals copied to perfection and ancient ink replicated, our scribes deliver a flawlessly forged royal genealogy granting you a direct claim upon their realm.
column3: Une revendication parfaite a été forgée.
column6: Una reclamación perfecta ha sido falsificada.

column2: As Grandmaster, you summon the full power of the Whispering Quill. Within days, would-be assassins are intercepted in castle shadows, and hostile conspirators flee the realm in panic!
column3: L'inquisition secrète a déjoué tous les complots ennemis !
column4: Alle feindlichen Mörder wurden im Schatten abgefangen!
column6: ¡La inquisición secreta ha desbaratado todos los complots ennemis!

column3: Nulle lame n'atteint le Grand Maître.

column2: One of your couriers was captured and interrogated by local palace guards! While your exact name was not immediately signed, dark rumors are spreading, and eyes are watching your movements with heavy suspicion.
column3: L'un de vos messagers a été capturé ! Les soupçons pèsent lourdement sur vous.
column4: Einer Eurer Boten wurde gefasst! Argwöhnische Blicke verfolgen Eure Schritte.
column6: ¡Uno de vuestros mensajeros ha sido capturado! Las sospechas recaen sobre vos.

column2: Curse it all, they know my name!
column3: Maudit soit-il, ils connaissent mon nom !

column2: The evidence is irrefutable. Documents bearing your private wax seal and coded cyphers have been laid before the royal court! You are publicly branded a dangerous criminal conspirator. Your liege has lawful right to imprison you and seize your lands!
column3: Vos crimes sont révélés au grand jour ! Votre suzerain peut légalement vous emprisonner.
column4: Eure Verbrechen wurden offengelegt! Euer Lehnsherr hat nun das Recht, Euch einzukerkern.
column6: ¡Vuestros crímenes han sido expuestos! Vuestro señor feudal tiene derecho legal a encarcelaros.
El juego se ha vuelto mortal...

column2: Because you have been publicly unmasked, the Grand Council of the Whispering Quill considers you a dangerous liability. A cloaked assassin corners you in your private study: 'Silence must be bought, brother... or delivered in cold steel.'
column3: L'Ordre exige un tribut pour acheter votre silence ou vous éliminer.
column4: Der Orden fordert Tribut für Euer Schweigen oder Euren Tod.
column6: La Orden exige tributo para comprar vuestro silencio o vuestra muerte.

column2: Take the gold and protect me! (200 Gold)
column4: Nehmt das Gold und schützt mich!

column3: Tu ne me fais pas peur !

column2: The Grand Council of the Whispering Quill has assigned you a covert task: infiltrate a rival court, plant surveillance, and retrieve secret correspondence for the archives.
column3: L'Ordre vous confie une mission d'espionnage.
column4: Der Orden beauftragt Euch mit einer verdeckten Mission.
column6: La Orden os encomienda una misión de espionaje.

column2: I will execute the mission at once.
column4: Ich werde die Mission unverzüglich ausführen.

column2: I cannot risk this right now.
column3: Je ne peux pas m'y risquer.
column4: Das Risiko ist mir derzeit zu hoch.

column2: You have successfully completed your covert assignment. The sealed documents are safely stored in the society's vault, and your standing within the brotherhood rises!
column3: Vous avez accompli votre mission avec succès.
column4: Ihr habt die verdeckte Mission erfolgreich beendet!
column5: ¡Habéis completado vuestra misión encubierta con éxito!

column2: This character is locked in an ancestral blood feud against a rival dynasty. The honor of their house demands blood.
column3: Cet individu est engagé dans une querelle de sang.
column4: Dieser Charakter ist in eine Blutfehde verwickelt.
column6: Este personaje está enzarzado en una venganza de sangre.

column2: This character has sworn personal vengeance against a hated enemy.
column3: Cet individu a juré vengeance contre un ennemi juré.
column6: Este personaje ha jurado venganza contra un enemigo jurado.

column2: A cunning spider who weaves networks of leverage, whispers, and court chicanery.
column3: Un tisseur d'ombres et de secrets de cour.
column4: Ein Meister der Einflüsterungen und Ränke.
column6: Un tejedor de secretos e intrigas cortesanas.

column2: This character holds the true power behind the throne of a weak or underage sovereign.
column3: Détient le véritable pouvoir derrière le trône.
column4: Hält die wahre Macht hinter dem Thron.
column6: Ostenta el verdadero poder detrás del trono.

column2: The sins and tyranny of forefathers cling heavily to this character's name.
column3: Les péchés des ancêtres pèsent sur ce nom.
column4: Die Sünden der Vorfahren lasten auf diesem Namen.
column6: Los pecados de los antepasados pesan sobre este linaje.

column2: Through great piety and restitution, this character has cleansed their house's dark past.
column3: La maison a purifié son sombre passé.
column4: Das Haus hat seine dunkle Vergangenheit gesühnt.
column6: La casa ha limpiado su oscuro pasado.

column2: Foreign spies and shadow informants have infiltrated this court, compromising security and uncovering sensitive secrets.
column3: Des espions étrangers ont infiltré cette cour.
column4: Fremde Spione haben diesen Hof infiltriert.
column6: Espías extranjeros han infiltrado esta corte.

column2: The call for ancestral vengeance drives the levies and knights of this realm to fight with ruthless zeal.
column3: La soif de vengeance anime les troupes.
column4: Der Ruf nach Rache beflügelt die Krieger.
column6: La sed de venganza impulsa a las tropas.

column2: This ruler has triumphed in a blood feud war, winning glorious renown and establishing supremacy over their rivals.
column3: A triomphé dans une guerre de sang.
column6: Ha triunfado en una guerra de sangre.

column2: Crushed in a blood feud war, this house has been humiliated, forced to pay heavy reparations, and stripped of ancestral standing.
column3: Déshonoré et vaincu dans une guerre de sang.
column6: Deshonrado y vencido en la venganza.

column2: As Shadow Regent, this ruler is actively skimming gold from their liege's realm taxes.
column3: Ce dirigeant détourne les impôts de son suzerain.
column4: Zweigt heimlich Gelder des Lehnsherrn ab.

column2: Corrupt regents and court schemers have bled the royal coffers dry, causing economic distress.
column3: Le trésor royal a été vidé par des régents corrompus.
column4: Korrupte Regenten haben die Kasse geleert.
column6: Regentes corruptos han vaciado el tesoro.

column2: Vassals and courtiers whisper in fear of this ruler's ruthless tyranny and iron grip.
column3: Les vassaux tremblent de terreur devant ce tyran.
column4: Vasallen zittern vor Angst vor diesem Herrscher.
column6: Los vasallos tiemblan de miedo ante este tirano.

column2: A formal peace treaty and marriage reconciliation has brought an end to an ancestral dynastic feud.
column3: Un traité de paix a mis fin à la querelle de sang.
column4: Ein Friedensvertrag hat die Blutfehde beendet.
column6: Un tratado de paz ha puesto fin a la venganza.

column2: Formally escalate your house's grievances against [Root.GetTitledName] into a generational blood feud.
column3: Escalader le conflit en une querelle de sang.
column4: Eskaliert die Feindschaft in eine Blutfehde.
column6: Escalar el conflicto a una venganza de sangre.

column2: Challenge [Root.GetTitledName] to single combat at dawn to settle your blood debt with steel.
Attempt to bury the hatchet with [Root.GetTitledName] through restitution and blood marriage.
Send your trusted informants to infiltrate the court of [Root.GetTitledName] and uncover illicit secrets.
column3: Infiltrer la cour pour découvrir des secrets.

column2: Use held leverage against [Root.GetTitledName] to demand gold or absolute political compliance.
column3: Utiliser un secret pour exiger de l'or ou de l'obéissance.
column4: Erpresst diesen Vasallen für Gold oder Gunst.
column6: Usar secretos para exigir oro u obediencia.
Asumir la Regencia de las Sombras

column2: Take effective control of state affairs behind a weak or pliable liege.
column3: Prendre le contrôle effectif du royaume.
column4: Übernimmt die Kontrolle hinter einem schwachen Herrscher.
column6: Tomar el control efectivo del reino.

column2: Secretly divert portions of the realm's tax revenue into your personal treasury.
column4: Leitet Steuereinnahmen in die eigene Tasche.
column6: Desviar ingresos fiscales a la tesorería personal.

column2: During the grand banquet, a sharp insult is hurled across the high table by [From.GetTitledName]. Your ancestors are mocked, and the honor of your house is dragged through the mud before all the realm's nobility.
column3: Un affront public déshonore votre maison au milieu du banquet.
column4: Ein bitterer Schandfleck wird über Euer Haus geworfen.
column6: Un amargo insulto deshonra a vuestra casa en mitad del banquete.

column2: Steel and blood shall answer this!

column3: Une Maison Marquée par le Sang
column6: Una Casa Marcada por la Sangre

column2: Word reaches your court: [From.GetTitledName] and their dynasty have formally sworn eternal blood vengeance against your house. Guard your back, for the shadows now hold daggers.
column3: La querelle de sang est officiellement déclarée.
column6: La venganza de sangre ha sido declarada oficialmente.

column2: A herald arrives bearing a challenge of honor! [From.GetTitledName] demands you meet them at dawn with drawn steel to settle your debts.
column3: Un héraut apporte un défi au lever du jour.
column4: Ein Bote überbringt die Forderung zum Ehrenduell.
column6: Un heraldo trae un desafío al amanecer.

column2: I accept! Meet me on the field.
I will not dignify this madness.
Under the mist of the morning meadow, blades clash in furious combat with [From.GetTitledName]! With a decisive strike, you overcome your opponent!
column3: Vos lames s'entrechoquent et vous triomphez !
column4: Die Klingen kreuzen sich und Ihr triumphiert!

column2: Honor is restored to my house!
The duel with [From.GetTitledName] went poorly. Disarmed and battered, you barely escape the field with your life.
column4: Ihr wurdet im Duell schwer geschlagen.
column6: Habéis sido derrotado en el duelo.

column2: Tired of endless bloodshed, [From.GetTitledName] sends an emissary proposing to bury the hatchet through marriage and restitution.
column3: Votre rival propose une trêve durable.
column4: Euer Rivale schlägt eine Versöhnung vor.
column6: Vuestro rival propone una tregua duradera.

column2: Let peace reign between our houses.
Never! There can be no peace.
Envoys return from [From.GetTitledName] with signed parchments and pledges of peace. The blood feud is brought to a close.
column3: La querelle de sang est enfin terminée.
column6: La venganza de sangre ha terminado por fin.

column2: Our forces have utterly crushed our feud rivals in open warfare! Their banners lie trampled in the mud, and our house's vengeance is carved into history.
column3: Nos armées ont triomphé dans la guerre de sang !
column4: Unsere Truppen haben die Feinde vernichtet!
column6: ¡Nuestras fuerzas han aplastado a nuestros rivales!

column2: Bitter Defeat in the Blood Feud
Our armies are broken, and our strongholds breached. We have been forced to accept humiliating peace terms and surrender massive reparations to our hated rivals.
column3: Nous sommes vaincus et contraints de payer de lourdes réparations.
column4: Wir wurden geschlagen und müssen Reparationen zahlen.
column6: Hemos sido derrotados y obligados a pagar pesadas reparaciones.

column2: As our siege engineers breach the castle gates, our men-at-arms capture a noble of the rival house hiding in the inner keep!
column3: Nos hommes ont capturé un noble de la maison rivale !
column4: Wir haben einen adligen Feind gefangen genommen!
column6: ¡Hemos capturado a un noble de la casa rival!

column2: Throw them into the oubliette as leverage.
Your informants return from the court of [From.GetTitledName] with damning evidence! They have uncovered dark, illicit secrets that grant you immense leverage over them.
column3: Vos espions ont découvert un secret accablant.
column4: Eure Informanten haben brisante Geheimnisse entdeckt.
column6: Vuestros informantes han descubierto un secreto comprometedor.

column2: This secret belongs to me now.
Plant a permanent mole in their court.
column6: Plantar un topo permanente en su corte.

column2: You confront [From.GetTitledName] with the secrets you hold over their head. Trapped and terrified of public ruin, they yield to your demands.
column3: Le noble cède à vos exigences de chantage.
column4: Der Adlige beugt sich Euren Forderungen.
column6: El noble cede a vuestras exigencias de chantaje.

column2: Empty your coffers into my purse.
With the sovereign young and pliable, all state affairs and royal decrees now pass through your private study. You are the true master of the realm.
column3: Vous êtes le véritable maître derrière le trône.
column4: Ihr seid nun der wahre Herrscher hinter dem Thron.
column6: Sois el verdadero amo detrás del trono.

column2: Long live the King... in his chambers.
column3: Longue vie au Roi... dans sa chambre.
column4: Lang lebe der König... in seinen Gemächern.
column6: Larga vida al Rey... en sus aposentos.

column2: Having reached adulthood, you sit upon the royal dais for your first solo court session. Your shadow regent stands before you, awaiting your command.
column3: Ayant atteint l'âge adulte, vous faites face à votre ancien régent.
column4: Erwachsen geworden steht Ihr Eurem Schattenregenten gegenüber.
column6: Habiendo alcanzado la mayoría de edad, os enfrentáis a vuestro regente de las sombras.

column2: Guards! Throw this usurper in the dungeon!
column4: Wachen! Werft diesen Usurpator in den Kerker!
column6: ¡Guardias! ¡Arrojad a este usurpador a las mazmorras!

column2: We shall continue to rule as partners.
Upon your coronation night, visions and eerie whispers of your forefather's dark deeds echo through the stone corridors. Will you walk their bloody path or seek redemption?
column3: Les péchés de votre père hantent la couronne.
column4: Die Sünden Eures Vaters suchen die Krone heim.
column6: Los pecados de vuestro padre acechan la corona.

column2: Let them fear me as they feared him!
column6: ¡Que me teman como le temían a él!

column2: I shall atone and cleanse our name.
